_extra_signals_comment: Extra signals. SHADOW (enabled:false, evaluated only under include_disabled in offline replay): no_successful_patch (BLOCKING -- a submission with no patch-phase edit recorded success is a consequential, correctable state; blocks once per run); plan_compliance_stale_validation (ADVISORY/non-blocking -- an ordering proxy that the latest edit was never re-checked; qualified wording, reminds once); validation_execution_unconfirmed (python-centric run_test classifier); submission_after_reported_check_failure (pytest-centric outcome parser, null on Pro); regression_validation_missing (rejected: fires ~44% of submits, RD~0). All once_per_key: some studied executor models cannot run project tests reliably, so a repeated block/nag would mislead. Wording stays QUALIFIED (confirm/rerun/explain): run_test/outcome are tool labels, not verified execution/relevance/pass facts. The global non_blocking_action_kinds:['view'] veto still applies on top.

advice.template: You are about to submit, but none of your edits were recorded as applied successfully, so the submission would contain no source change. The target text for a replacement may not have matched the file. Re-check the edit location and apply the fix so it actually takes effect before submitting.

stale_validation._intervention: ADVISORY: this is an ordering proxy (a recorded successful edit follows the last recognized check run), not a confirmed violation, so it reminds but does not block -- the agent may have good reason the earlier result still holds, and run_test is only a tool label.

advice.template: A patch recorded as successful follows your last recognized check run, so your latest changes may not have been re-checked. If they changed the final code, rerun the relevant checks before submitting; otherwise confirm the earlier results still apply. If checks cannot run, explain the limitation rather than retrying setup indefinitely.

Validation activity is recorded, but no test/check run is recognized. Before submitting, run a suitable check if you have not already; otherwise confirm how the final changes were validated. If checks cannot run, explain the limitation rather than retrying setup indefinitely.
The last recorded validation was marked as failed. Inspect its output before submitting. Resolve a regression or setup problem, or explain why the result is expected or unrelated.
Plan compliance violation: you are validating in the {phase} phase before you have patched the code. Implement the fix first, then validate it.
